sealed_candidate.answer: ## Decision: Not proven — the packet does not establish a ≥20% total-cost reduction**Bottom line:** The packet contains no cost measurements at all. Its only quantitative datum is a pilot note reporting **40 accepted pull requests in one month** [measurement-context], and the packet's own measurement policy **explicitly prohibits inferring causal benefit from accepted-PR counts** [measurement-policy]. No baseline, no total-cost numerator or denominator, and no matched comparison exist in the packet, so a causal cost reduction of at least 20% is neither demonstrated nor estimable.**What the packet contains**- A measurement policy specifying the required evaluation design: matched tasks, quality gates, human review time, rework, elapsed lead time, and total cost, with failed or abandoned tasks counted [measurement-policy].- A pilot note reporting 40 accepted PRs in one month, explicitly lacking task mix, control group, reviewer hours, failure count, and provider costs [measurement-context].**Why the threshold cannot be assessed**- None of the policy-required measures (including total cost and failure counting) appear in the pilot record [measurement-policy, measurement-context].- The sole reported metric is inadmissible for this decision under the packet's own rules [measurement-policy].**Preserved tension:** The pilot's headline figure (accepted PRs) is the only number available, yet the policy bars using it for causal benefit claims. This is a methodological conflict within the packet rather than a factual contradiction; the context note does not itself assert a cost benefit.**Unresolved limits**- No cost figure in either direction can be computed from the packet; the ≥20% claim is untested, not disproven.- The 40-PR figure has no stated denominator (tasks attempted), no failure or abandonment count, and covers a single month.- Any cost claim would require a new matched, policy-conformant evaluation before it can support a decision.**Recommended action:** Do not record or communicate a 20% cost reduction as established. Treat the threshold as unresolved pending a matched evaluation per the packet's measurement policy.
